app ProbeB1
Given
 Order {reference:text unique, state:text?}
 Receipt in Order {source:text unique, accepted:int min=0, ordered:int min=0, posting:text?}
 policy Order read=members
 policy Receipt read=members
When
 crud Order by=members fields=reference
 crud Receipt by=members fields=source,accepted
 scenario receive(line:Order,source:text,accepted:int) -> Receipt by=members
  do
   let previous=first(Receipt as receipt where receipt.source==source order=receipt.id)
   if previous!=null
    require previous.parent==line and previous.accepted==accepted
    return previous
   create Receipt {parent=line,source,accepted,ordered=accepted} as receipt
   return receipt
Then
